title: Cost Sentinel: coordinated field trials and rollout for batching, KV lifecycle, and quantization profiles
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Execute coordinated field trials that validate and safely roll out cost-saving configurations across three levers: request batching, KV cache lifecycle (TTL/eviction policies), and per-workload quantization profiles. Unlike earlier ad-hoc experiments, this initiative packages experiments, guardrails, and rollout artifacts so product teams can opt into automated savings with predictable quality trade-offs.

Scope: -- define experiment matrix and traffic weighting; -- implement standardized telemetry hooks and failure-mode fallbacks; -- validate quality on representative prompt sets; -- bake rollout automation for console and API (canary by customer tier).

Deliverables: experiment matrix, telemetry dashboard, regression gating alerts, canary rollout playbook, customer opt-in UI changes, and a post-rollout savings audit report.
acceptance_criteria: Field trials executed for representative workloads (search, chat, embeddings) with >95% pass rate on quality gates
At least one baseline-to-variant regression test per workload with LLM eval metrics linked to alerts
Canary automation is able to progressively increase conversion from 0% to target traffic without manual intervention
Telemetry includes per-route cost-per-1k-tokens, median latency, and regression signal within the console dashboard
Post-rollout audit shows sustained cost savings and no user-facing regressions for 14 days
metrics_targets: 10% aggregate per-token cost reduction for canary cohorts versus baseline on synthetic benchmark
<3% change in user-facing quality score (acceptance threshold depends on workload) during canary
Median tail latency increase <50ms for 95th percentile while batching is active
KV cache hit rate >20% on chat workloads with configured TTLs in regionally representative traffic

2026-02-28: Telemetry schema and dashboard prototype merged (ENG-90512)
2026-03-07: Run closed alpha field trials on internal traffic and 2 pilot customers
2026-03-21: Canary automation enabled for tiered rollout with automatic rollback on regression
2026-04-04: Open opt-in rollout to broader customer base and monitor 14-day audit window
2026-04-15: Close initiative with savings report and recommended defaults
experiments: Batch size dynamic shaping: evaluate fixed small batches vs. workload-adaptive batching windows
KV lifecycle variants: short TTL (10s), medium TTL (60s), and adaptive TTL based on conversation activity
Quantization profile sweep: fp16, 8-bit symmetric, and 4-bit per-layer mixed profiles with fallback to fp16 on quality regression
Combined arms: testing batching+KV+quant mixes to quantify interaction effects on latency and quality
risks_and_mitigations: Quality regressions impacting NPS: mitigation = strong eval gating + immediate rollback + canary caps
Unexpected latency spikes under heavy batching: mitigation = upper-bound batch window and latency SLO fallback path
Telemetry gaps across dedicated/private deployments: mitigation = lightweight SDK hook and offline log ingestion for private deployments
Customer confusion about opt-in behavior: mitigation = in-console explanatory copy, explicit consent, and per-customer dashboards
